title: Cleveland Guardians vs. Tampa Bay Rays: Listen Live to the AL Championship Series
summary: Catch the entire best-of-seven series on SiriusXM, with the winner advancing to the 2026 World Series.
body_markdown:
The[Cleveland Guardians](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/cleveland-guardians) and[Tampa Bay Rays](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/tampa-bay-rays) face off in the 2026 American League Championship Series, with every[MLB](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/live-mlb-games) postseason game available live on SiriusXM in the car and on the app.


[Guardians vs. Rays October 12 • 8pm ET Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMLB26-Playoffs-GuardiansRays)
